metadata.title: Retro Watercolor Sun and Sketch Illustration

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, nostalgic composition featuring a large concentric watercolor sun behind a simple line-art figure on aged paper texture.
triggerTerms: simple ink sketch with watercolor wash
excludeWhen: high-contrast digital neon colors are requested
modern minimalist sans-serif layouts are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, textured orange-to-yellow watercolor sun composed of concentric rings dominates the center-left, serving as a backdrop for a minimalist ink-drawn girl holding a glowing orb. The entire scene is set against a cream-colored, aged paper background with typography tucked into the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Large watercolor sun as a framing device for the subject
High-contrast black ink lines against soft warm washes
Top-right heavy typography balancing the bottom-left heavy illustration
Textural interplay between rough paper grain and bleeding watercolor edges
coreInvariants: Concentric watercolor rings with visible bleeding edges
Cream or aged yellow paper base texture
Simple, single-weight ink line drawing style

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a small line-art figure positioned in the lower left quadrant, overlapping the large central sun.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange watercolor circle acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large sun, move to the figure on the left, and then travel to the text block in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space on the right side and top edge, emphasizing the paper texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and cream (background and sun core)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value; colors feel faded and organic.
paletteRestrictions: No pure whites; all highlights are cream-toned

letterConstructionRules: Extreme stroke contrast in display text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair a high-contrast display serif with a slab-serif or typewriter-style font for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high stroke contrast and elegant terminals of the display text.
Matches the nostalgic, printed feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage cream paper background with a large, centered-left watercolor sun made of bleeding concentric rings in yellow and orange. Include a simple black ink line drawing of a girl in the lower left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply high-contrast black serif typography in the upper right corner, ensuring the ampersand is decorative and larger than the surrounding letters.

verificationChecks: Is the watercolor texture visible and bleeding?
Is the paper texture aged and cream-colored?
Is the typography aligned to the top right?
Is the color palette strictly warm (yellows, oranges, browns)?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sun rings are not perfectly concentric to maintain the hand-painted look.
Check that the ink lines have a slight 'bleed' into the paper texture.
Verify the typography does not overlap the main illustration elements.
Confirm the ampersand has a distinct decorative flourish.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [watercolor concentric circles] + [vintage paper texture] + [minimalist ink line art] + [high-contrast serif typography in top-right corner].
